correctness.rationale: Reconstructed independently from the cubic cube-dart graph and exact Euclidean-coordinate graph. All 26,440 nonempty simplices were enumerated; 13,211 matched pairs and 18 critical cells (one vertex, five dimension-five cells, twelve dimension-six cells) are verified, together with acyclicity of all 143,760 oriented face incidences. Exact signed gradient-path recurrence gives a 5x12 cellular boundary with nonzero entries only at (4,5),(4,6),(5,5),(5,6) with -1 and (4,9),(5,9) with +1 (1-based). Its rows are equal, its rank is one, and a 1x1 maximal minor has determinant -1. Integral cellular cancellation leaves four 5-cells and eleven 6-cells attached trivially; the Hurewicz isomorphism shows the degree matrix classifies their attaching maps. A second, independent geometric construction and mod-2 simplicial boundary computation confirms reduced ranks 4 in degree 5 and 11 in degree 6.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical 24-vertex Archimedean truncated-cube skeleton, rather than an arbitrary induced or parameter-sliced graph. Its complete integral independence-complex homotopy type has mixed adjacent sphere dimensions. A nonzero integral Morse attaching degree and its unit cancellation provide information not determined by face counts, Euler characteristic, connectivity bounds, or field homology. This is a natural exact polyhedral invariant and reproducible benchmark; no family-wide theorem is asserted.
